stock.description: Operating as an investment holding company, Xinyi Electric Storage Holdings Limited focuses its operations within the People's Republic of China, encompassing energy storage solutions, EPC services, automotive glass repair and replacement, and various other ventures. The company provides a range of lithium battery products, alongside complete battery pack and energy storage systems. These lithium-ion based systems serve diverse applications, such as industrial power banks for load shifting and grid stabilization in manufacturing plants, uninterruptible power supplies (UPS), and household energy storage units. Beyond energy storage, Xinyi Electric Storage delivers contract processing services and specializes in Engineering, Procurement, and Construction (EPC) for solar power facilities. Its automotive division offers comprehensive glass repair and replacement services. Furthermore, the company's portfolio extends to forklift trading, managing wind farm operations, and investing in and developing new wind farm projects. Its product offerings in the automotive glass sector include various types such as laminated, tempered, heated laminated, specialized tempered, Solar-X solar reflective, and water-repelling glass. Supporting its operations are four service centers and a dedicated motorcade service team. Established in 1996, the company, originally named Xinyi Automobile Glass Hong Kong Enterprises Limited, maintains its headquarters in Kowloon, Hong Kong.
